notes:
Summary: StitchCode is building a VS Code-first codex assistant (internal + OSS customers) and evaluating Redwood for low‑latency streaming completions and pin-able model versions. Primary ask: production-quality inline suggestions with sub-50ms median latency for short completions and streaming for multi-line transforms.

Key requirements / asks (CRM-style):
- Runtime: low-latency streaming via SSE/websocket; chunked partial tokens for immediate inline display. want predictable tail (95th < 200ms) for 8–12 token suggestions.
- TD/Throughput: initial pilot ~500 dev seats, burst concurrency up to 300 concurrent editors per org, expected sustain QPS ~40 req/s per org.
- Model/version pinning: must be able to pin extension to specific model version (e.g., code-small-v2) per workspace and rollback without extension updates.
- Auth: SSO/SAML SSO + short-lived tokens for extension; token refresh flow must be seamless in VS Code (no frequent reauth prompts). OAuth device flow preferred for laptops.
- Rate limits / quotas: tenant-level quotas and per-user rate-limits. product team wants graceful 429 handling with fallback (local heuristic suggestions) and clear retry-after headers.
- Caching: repo-aware prefix caching (KV) to avoid repeat context fetches; offline cache for last session suggestions (works in restricted network).
- Telemetry & privacy: telemetry only aggregated; must support opt-out at org level. No file contents retention beyond 30 days; encryption-at-rest with customer KMS.
- Compliance: SOC2 is minimum; security team asked for ISO27001 and details on data residency (EU for EU customers).
- Billing: token-level billing preferred + seat-based pricing for enterprise; dev team asked for invoice granularity by team.

POC plan / success criteria:
- 2-week technical pilot: integrate Redwood-hosted VS Code extension in a dev org (50 power users) with metrics: median time‑to‑first­suggestion < 40ms, 95th percentile latency < 200ms, successful model pin/rollback test, streaming continuity across file edits.
- Observability: need per-route dashboards (latency, token counts), trace IDs in extension logs, cost-breakdown per-team.
- Quality: A/B test default model vs pinned code model; target token-accuracy improvement on unit prompt set > 8% relative to current baseline.

Quotes / call snippets:
- "We can't have suggestions stall or show large gaps — developers will disable the plugin instantly." — Frontend Eng mgr
- "If we can pin to a model for an entire team and get reproducible responses, we can adopt at scale." — Head of Platform

Open items / blockers:
- Security needs detailed KMS/HSM architecture and key rotation policy (SEC-1201 ticket).
- Legal needs DPA edits for EU residency clause and processor sub‑processors list.
- Finance needs pilot pricing for 500 seats; pricing sensitivity noted (target ARR < $150k first year).

Ask to Redwood team (next actions):
- Provide detailed KMS/HSM integration doc + sample KMS policy.
- Prep a paired SE session to exercise rate-limit & fallback paths in VS Code extension (Ravi assigned).
- Draft pilot SOW and seat-pricing options for 3-month pilot.
